landing.heroTitle: Your loved one's care, all in one place
landing.heroText: Medication, medical appointments, documents and alerts for your elderly family member, organized and shared with the whole family. No WhatsApp chains, no spreadsheets.
landing.point1Text: Who gives each dose, confirmed with one tap. An alert if something is missed.
landing.point2Text: Medical appointments and visits visible to the whole family, with reminders.
landing.point3Text: Reports, insurance and important documents, organized and protected.
landing.disclaimer: Cerca is a family organization tool. It does not provide medical advice or replace healthcare professionals. In an emergency, call 112.
